note: This file is a pure MMDetection3D configuration file with no callable functions, classes, or APIs. It defines model architecture (ImVoxelNet with ResNet50 backbone, FPN neck, ScanNetImVoxelHeadV2 head), training hyperparameters (AdamW optimizer, 12 epochs, step LR schedule), data pipeline (MultiViewPipeline with 30 train / 51 test images, ScanNet dataset), and evaluation settings (NMS, IoU threshold) for 3D object detection on ScanNet with 18 classes using covariance-with-mean volume rendering.
